{{Top|canon=Rapid Rail Transport}}
[[File:RailJet-DM.png|thumb|right|250px|A rail jet ran through the ship.]]
A '''rail jet''' was a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] that traveled on one rail and transported ammunition, supplies and sometimes troops.

==History==
One rail jet transportation system was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="DM">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Another one was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].

==Behind the scenes==
The shape of the rail jet cars used aboard the ''Malevolence'' was inspired by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="DMEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode004.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
